Overview.Name: Swetha Reddy
Overview.Goal: Improve daily energy and gradually support healthy fat loss.

Early_Morning: Option 1: Warm water + plain milk (small cup)
Option 2: Warm water + small bowl curd
Meal_1_Breakfast: Option 1: Paneer bhurji (pan fried) + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Curd bowl + cooked vegetable side
Option 3: Rice rawa upma (small portion) with vegetables
Meal_2_Lunch: Option 1: Plain rice (small portion) + dal + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Plain rice (small portion) + paneer curry + vegetables
Option 3: Plain rice (small portion) + chicken curry (small portion) + vegetables
Meal_3_Dinner: Option 1: Paneer curry + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables
Option 2: Dal + small portion plain rice + vegetables
Option 3: Curd + small portion plain rice + cooked vegetables

Notes_and_Tips: Since yoga is newly started, keep meals simple and regular.
Avoid skipping meals to support thyroid health.
For sweet cravings, start meals with protein and eat slowly.
Keep fried foods occasional to prevent overeating.
Small rice portions help consistency without feeling restricted.
Focus on energy, digestion, and routine rather than quick weight loss.
